cards.ex: His negative attitude became a self-fulfilling prophecy; he expected to fail, so he didn't try hard, and then he failed.
cards.exUz: Uning salbiy munosabati o'zini oqlaydigan bashoratga aylandi; u muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashini kutdi, shuning uchun u qattiq harakat qilmadi va keyin muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Agar odam bir narsaga ishonib, o'shanga mos harakat qilsa, bashorat amalga oshadi.

cards.ex: Her speech was cut short by a sudden power outage.
cards.exUz: Uning nutqi to'satdan elektr uzilishi bilan to'xtatildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani erta tugatmoq yoki to'xtatmoq, odatda kutilmaganda.

cards.ex: The kingdom was lost for want of a nail; it shows how important details are.
cards.exUz: Mix yetishmasligi tufayli qirollik yo'qotildi; bu tafsilotlarning qanchalik muhimligini ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik narsaning yetishmasligi katta muammolarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The company's success can be attributed to its innovative marketing strategies.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning muvaffaqiyati uning innovatsion marketing strategiyalari bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir kelib chiqishini biror narsaga yoki kimdirga bog'lash.

cards.ex: Poverty and lack of education create a vicious cycle that's hard to break.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik va ta'limning yetishmasligi yomon aylanishni yaratadi, uni buzish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Bir muammo boshqa muammolarni keltirib chiqaradigan va vaziyatni yomonlashtiradigan jarayon.

cards.ex: A quiet environment is conducive to studying.
cards.exUz: Tinch muhit o'qishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga yordam berish yoki sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: In the interest of safety, please remain seated.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik manfaatlar yo'lida, iltimos, o'tirgan joyingizda qoling.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga foyda keltirish maqsadida.

cards.ex: The trial became a cause célèbre, drawing attention from around the world.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayoni mashhur ishga aylandi va butun dunyoning e'tiborini tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy qiziqish uyg'otgan bahsli ish yoki voqea.

cards.ex: The media's coverage can feed into public opinion.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining yoritilishi jamoatchilik fikriga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa boshqa narsaga ta'sir qilib, uni kuchaytirmoq yoki o'zgartirmoq.

cards.ex: Stress is often a contributing factor to heart disease.
cards.exUz: Stress ko'pincha yurak kasalliklarining asosiy omilidir.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga yordam beradigan omil, lekin yagona sabab emas.

cards.ex: For all intents and purposes, the project is complete.
cards.exUz: Deyarli, loyiha tugallandi.
cards.uzDef: Amalda, haqiqatda; deyarli to'liq ma'noda.

cards.ex: The detective realized the clue was a red herring.
cards.exUz: Detektiv bu dalil diqqatni chalg'ituvchi narsa ekanligini angladi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni asosiy masaladan chalg'ituvchi narsa.

cards.ex: She traveled the world in pursuit of adventure.
cards.exUz: U sarguzasht izlash maqsadida dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The agreement set the stage for future cooperation.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv kelajakdagi hamkorlik uchun sharoit yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga sharoit yaratmoq.

cards.ex: The initial investment had a snowball effect on the company's growth.
cards.exUz: Boshlang'ich sarmoya kompaniyaning o'sishiga qor uyumi effekti ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik boshlangan narsa asta-sekin kattalashib boradigan jarayon.

cards.ex: Technology played a significant part in the company's success.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya kompaniyaning muvaffaqiyatida muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishida rol o'ynamoq.

cards.ex: They invested in the project with an eye to long-term profits.
cards.exUz: Ular uzoq muddatli foyda olish maqsadida loyihaga sarmoya kiritdilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani maqsad qilib, unga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Legalizing marijuana could be a slippery slope to legalizing all drugs.
cards.exUz: Marixuanani qonuniylashtirish barcha giyohvand moddalarni qonuniylashtirishga olib keladigan xavfli yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bitta harakat asta-sekin yomonroq natijalarga olib keladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The politician pandered to the crowd's prejudices.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi olomonning xurofotlariga moslashdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning xohish-istaklariga moslashish, ko'pincha tanqidga loyiq tarzda.

cards.ex: The funds were used in furtherance of the charity's goals.
cards.exUz: Mablag'lar xayriya tashkilotining maqsadlarini rivojlantirish uchun ishlatildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishishga yordam berish uchun.

cards.ex: Taxes are a necessary evil for funding public services.
cards.exUz: Soliqlar davlat xizmatlarini moliyalashtirish uchun zarur yomonlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Yomon bo'lsa ham, keraksiz natijalarni oldini olish uchun zarur bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Corruption is at the root of many of the country's problems.
cards.exUz: Korruptsiya mamlakat muammolarining asosida turadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababini yoki manbaini aniqlash.

cards.ex: The success of the plan is predicated on everyone's cooperation.
cards.exUz: Rejaning muvaffaqiyati har kimning hamkorligiga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa boshqa narsaga asoslangan yoki unga bog'liq bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The invention of the printing press was a catalyst for social change.
cards.exUz: Bosmaxonaning ixtirosi ijtimoiy o'zgarishlar uchun katalizator bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tezlashtiradigan yoki o'zgartiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: He didn't say anything for fear that he would offend her.
cards.exUz: U uni xafa qilishidan qo'rqib, hech narsa demadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror yomon narsa sodir bo'lishidan qo'rqib.

cards.ex: By reacting angrily, you're just playing into his hands.
cards.exUz: G'azab bilan javob berib, siz shunchaki uning qo'liga tushasiz.
cards.uzDef: Birovga o'zingiz bilmagan holda yordam bermoq, unga foyda keltirmoq.

cards.ex: I don't know all the whys and wherefores of the situation.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatning barcha sabablarini bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sabablari va tafsilotlari.

cards.ex: The discovery set in motion a series of events that changed the world.
cards.exUz: Bu kashfiyot dunyoni o'zgartirgan bir qator voqealarni harakatga keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror jarayonni boshlash yoki harakatga keltirish.

cards.ex: He succeeded by dint of hard work and determination.
cards.exUz: U qattiq mehnat va qat'iyatlilik tufayli muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga kuch, harakat yoki qobiliyat tufayli erishish.

cards.ex: The new laws aim to redress the balance between employers and employees.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonunlar ish beruvchilar va ishchilar o'rtasidagi muvozanatni tiklashga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Adolatsizlikni to'g'rilash yoki muvozanatni qayta tiklash.
